expo.name: Magic Wand
expo.description: Touch anything, transform it. Point your camera at the real world and watch whatever you touch turn to gold, ice, pixels, or paint — live.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Magic Wand uses the camera so the things you touch can transform live.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Magic Wand can use the microphone for voice-cast spells.
